headline: Russia launches massive Ukraine strike killing mother and two children
subheadline: Ballistic missiles and reactive Shahed drones hit Fastiv, Kyiv region, destroying civilian homes and injuring multiple families, while air defenses scrambled across eight oblasts.
lede: Russian forces carried out a coordinated overnight assault on Ukraine using ballistic missiles and Shahed drones, killing a mother and two children in Fastiv and damaging nine civilian objects across Kyiv region. Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets over at least eight oblasts, and President Zelensky unveiled a new interceptor drone system designed to counter the reactive Shahed UAVs. Meanwhile, Yemeni armed forces claimed missile and drone strikes on strategic sites in Riyadh and Yanbu, while the Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting Houthi attacks on multiple Saudi cities. US embassies issued STEP alerts for Israel, Iraq, Lebanon, and Oman amid Iranian diplomatic overtures via Qatar to end the war.

sections.title: Russia’s Massive Overnight Ukraine Strike Campaign
sections.body: Russian forces launched a combined strike using ballistic missiles and Shahed drones, killing a mother and two children in Fastiv, Kyiv region. Air alerts persisted for 24 hours across Kyiv, with nine civilian objects damaged in four districts, while ballistic missile threats targeted Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia. Reactive Shahed drones approached from Chernihiv, Bryansk, the Black Sea, and central Ukraine, and Ukrainian air defenses engaged multiple targets. President Zelensky demonstrated a new interceptor drone system to counter the reactive Shaheds, and the Russian Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of Zelena Dibrova, Maryevka, and Gulevo.

sections.title: Yemeni Strikes, Houthi Attacks, US Alerts
sections.body: Yemeni armed forces claimed missile and drone strikes on sensitive sites in Riyadh and Aramco facilities in Yanbu, while the Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting Houthi attacks on Bisha, Taif, Farasan, and Yanbu. US embassies issued STEP alerts for Israel, Iraq, Lebanon, and Oman, plus travel security alerts for Iraq, Kuwait, Jordan, Lebanon, Bahrain, and Oman, amid Iranian diplomatic overtures via Qatar to the US. In southern Lebanon, two IDF soldiers were lightly injured by a Hezbollah roadside bomb, prompting Israeli strikes on Hezbollah surveillance posts and attack sites, and Hamas commander Mohammed Suleiman Byouk was killed in an Israeli airstrike in Khan Younis. Iran’s security chief told Al Jazeera that Qatar conveyed Iran’s conditions to end the war to the US, awaiting Trump’s response, while Saudi Arabia seeks Pakistani and Turkish military intervention under the Mecca pact.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous Houthi strikes deep into Saudi territory and Hezbollah’s roadside bombing indicate a coordinated multi‑front pressure campaign against Israeli and Saudi interests, reflected in extensive US STEP alerts across seven Gulf and Levant states. Iran’s diplomatic channel via Qatar suggests a possible de‑escalation pathway, yet continued Israeli targeted killings of Hamas commanders and Saudi overtures for foreign military involvement signal ongoing kinetic operations and potential internationalization of the Yemen conflict.
